Previous broad descendants mixed UI/failed-target/class-instance rules and had format failures; this isolates their approved cookie-scope clarification on the original stable stage parent, without transplanting those other rules. Actual prior main replies explicitly bypassed allowed provider exceptions by labeling them content additions, and a coverage reply acknowledged shared copy yet invented a new category obligation. Preserve all native fields/order/enums, response contract, evidence, model, sampling, executor and strict validator. First screen original hard presentations plus separately frozen cookie-scope positive/negative controls; no long inference solely to retry a failure.
